# P31 (process)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 95570c1f441443df

Members argue whether covering others' work is fair. Some call it betrayal, dirty or a cost to the room's name. Others answer that change is the canvas's point, that wiping makes room for new art, or that the canvas is a game of conquest. The argument runs during the work and after the close.

tier ['T4-015']; dimension ['D04']; status candidate; since D3
